clauses.treatment_must_reach: treatment mean G_task LOW >= twin mean G_task LOW + 0.25 (twin value measured in the probe rerun; controls gave twin G_task LOW = 0.006, so about 0.256)

diagnostics.note: selection pressure for the constructed task content exists at the LOW budget and is ~0 at the HIGH budget, so the budget contrast carries a pressure difference (checked before freezing)

revisions.why: r1 positive control failed: gain 2.0 saturated tanh (units carried ~sign(u1_{t-3}), corr 0.905) and lambda=1e-6 made n=8 an exact interpolation that fitted residuals through small-norm directions; constructed reservoir scored NRMSE 1.7 at n=8 (worse than random, G_task -0.68). With gain 1.0 and lambda 1e-2 it scores 0.18 vs 1.11 random.

revisions.what: generations 30 -> 60, mutation sd 0.02 -> 0.05 (relative); twin and spec updated identically
revisions.why: r2 controls already attainable and discriminating; the change gives the treatment a fair chance to move the reservoir (total drift 0.02*sqrt(30) ~ 0.11 of rms was judged too small to reach any structured region), made before freezing; thresholds unchanged by it.
